highlights: 【High-Resolution LED Display】The YESIOD MG10 features a clear and easy-to-read high-resolution LED display for accurate weight measurements.
【Robust Construction】Made of tempered glass and ABS plastic, this scale combines robustness and elegant design for long-lasting durability.
【Wide Weight Range】This scale measures from 5 kg to 150 kg, making it suitable for a variety of users and purposes.
【Precision Measurements】With accuracy standards of ±300 g at 50 kg, ±400 g at 100 kg, and ±500 g at 150 kg, you can rely on the readings.
【Unit Conversion】Easily switch between kilograms (kg) and pounds (lb) for your preferred unit of measurement.
